scheme_name: Home for the Aged under Grant-in-Aid to Pondicherry Society for the Care of the Aged (PONCARE)
other_conditions: Must be a native/resident of the Union Territory of Puducherry for at least 5 years.
benefits_summary: Senior citizens receive stay at a subsidiary rate of ₹1200, along with food, thrice‑weekly health check‑ups, and entertainment facilities such as newspapers and television.
application_link: Step 1: Visit the Pondicherry Society for the Care of the Aged (PONCARE), Puducherry, 4th Cross - Sithankudi, 6th Cross Extension, Brindavanam, West, Puducherry - 605 013, call +91-413-2245317, +91-413-2246318, +91-9443405499, and request the hard copy of the prescribed application form. Step 2: Fill in all mandatory fields, paste the passport‑sized photograph (signed across, if required), and attach copies of all mandatory documents (self‑attest, if required). Step 3: Submit the completed form and documents to the Secretary, PONCARE. Step 4: Request a receipt or acknowledgement containing submission date, time, and a unique identification number (if applicable).
